name: Blitzball Stadium
oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, support X. (Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to X target creatures.)
Go for the Goal! — {3}, {T}: Until end of turn, target creature gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card for each kind of counter on it" and it can't be blocked this turn.
blocked_sentences: Go for the Goal! — {3}, {T}: Until end of turn, target creature gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card for each kind of counter on it" and it can't be blocked this turn.

needs.what: a value expression counting the number of distinct kinds of counters on an object (e.g. {"counter_kinds_on": {"objects": {"self_only": true}}}), so the granted trigger can 'draw a card for each kind of counter on it'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `counters_on` reads the count of one named kind, `has_counters` is only a filter, and `distinct` accepts of: power, basic_land_type, card_type, color only (DISTINCT_OF in engine/effects/values.py) -- none counts kinds of counters
